def validate_handoff_constraints(
    request: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    requester: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
    now_utc: datetime | None = None,
    now_epoch: float | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate cross-domain handoff request fail-closed (used by preflight & registration)."""
    qroot = state_root or _default_state_root()
    _assert_no_secrets(request, "request")
    _assert_no_untrusted_prompt(request, "request")

    source_domain = validate_domain_token(request.get("bounded_context"), field_name="source_domain")
    handoff_mode = _clean(request.get("mode") or "READ_ONLY").upper()
    if handoff_mode not in {"READ_ONLY", "MUTATION"}:
        raise HandoffError("HANDOFF_MODE_INVALID")

    source_objective = _clean(request.get("objective"))
    if not source_objective or len(source_objective) < 5 or len(source_objective) > MAX_OBJECTIVE_CHARS:
        raise HandoffError("HANDOFF_OBJECTIVE_INVALID")

    constraints = request.get("constraints")
    if not isinstance(constraints, Mapping):
        raise HandoffError("SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_INVALID")

    allowed_keys = {
        "target_domain",
        "source_job_id",
        "incident_id",
        "dependency_id",
        "authorization_ref",
        "acceptance_criteria",
        "requested_capability",
        "requested_constraints",
        "delegation_chain",
        "priority_class",
        "auto_dispatch",
        "resolution_job_id",
        "successor_spec",
        "existing_handoff_id",
    }
    extra = sorted(set(constraints.keys()) - allowed_keys)
    if extra:
        raise HandoffError(f"SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED:{','.join(extra)}")

    if "existing_handoff_id" in constraints:
        # A narrow ID-based continuation, never a new handoff or mutation successor.
        if set(constraints) != {"existing_handoff_id", "successor_spec"}:
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_ID_FIELDS_INVALID")
        if handoff_mode != "READ_ONLY":
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_ID_READ_ONLY_REQUIRED")
        hid = _validate_optional_token(constraints.get("existing_handoff_id"), field_name="existing_handoff_id", job_id_style=True)
        if not hid:
            raise HandoffError("HANDOFF_ID_INVALID")
        existing = load_handoff(hid, state_root=qroot)
        if existing is None:
            raise HandoffError("HANDOFF_NOT_FOUND")
        if existing.get("handoff_id") != hid or existing.get("source_domain") != source_domain:
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
        target = validate_domain_token(existing.get("target_domain"), field_name="target_domain")
        if existing.get("production_allowed") is not False or existing.get("production_touched") is not False:
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN")
        if existing.get("handoff_mode") != "READ_ONLY":
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_ID_READ_ONLY_REQUIRED")
        _verify_caller_rbac_and_scope(
            current_user=current_user, requester=requester, source_domain=source_domain,
            target_domain=target, handoff_mode="READ_ONLY",
        )
        spec = _validate_successor_spec(constraints.get("successor_spec"), source_domain=source_domain)
        if spec is None or spec["mode"] != "READ_ONLY" or spec.get("authorization_ref"):
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_ID_READ_ONLY_REQUIRED")
        fingerprint = existing.get("payload_fingerprint")
        if not fingerprint:
            raise HandoffSecurityError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT")
        prior = existing.get("successor_spec")
        if prior is not None and prior != spec:
            raise HandoffConflictError("HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR_ALREADY_DEFINED")
        if prior is None:
            _validate_existing_successor_registration(existing, spec, current_user=current_user)
        return {
            "duplicate": prior is not None, "pending_update": False,
            "successor_update": prior is None, "existing_handoff": existing,
            "successor_spec": spec, "handoff_id": hid,
            "dependency_id": existing["dependency_id"], "source_domain": source_domain,
            "target_domain": target, "request_key": existing["request_key"],
            "payload_fingerprint": fingerprint, "production_touched": False,
        }

def test_aap05_successor_by_id_preserves_original(tmp_path):
    qroot = _setup_queue(tmp_path)
    actor = _canonical_actor()
    request = {
        "objective": "Existing dependency for ID based continuation",
        "bounded_context": "SQL_RBAC_019", "mode": "READ_ONLY",
        "capability": "CROSS_DOMAIN_HANDOFF_REGISTER",
        "request_key": "aap05-original",
        "constraints": {"target_domain": "WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE", "auto_dispatch": False},
    }
    initial = handoff_mod.validate_handoff_constraints(request, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)
    record = dict(initial["candidate"])
    record.update(lifecycle_state="RETURNED_TO_SOURCE", dependency_satisfied=True,
                  certification="CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY", resolution_job_id="CERTIFIED-ORIGINAL")
    handoff_mod.save_handoff(record, state_root=qroot)
    hid = record["handoff_id"]
    spec = {"objective": "Read existing certified evidence", "bounded_context": "SQL_RBAC_019",
            "mode": "READ_ONLY", "capability": "WORKER_RESULT_DETAIL_READ",
            "request_key": "aap05-successor", "constraints": {"source_job_id": "CERTIFIED-ORIGINAL"}}
    req = {**request, "objective": "Continue by persistent handoff identifier",
           "request_key": "aap05-continuation",
           "constraints": {"existing_handoff_id": hid, "successor_spec": spec}}
    pf = handoff_mod.validate_handoff_constraints(req, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)
    assert pf["successor_update"] is True
    assert handoff_mod.load_handoff(hid, state_root=qroot) == record
    for invalid in (
        {**req, "bounded_context": "FINANZAS"},
        {**req, "mode": "MUTATION"},
        {**req, "constraints": {**req["constraints"], "auto_dispatch": True}},
        {**req, "constraints": {**req["constraints"], "successor_spec": {**spec, "mode": "MUTATION"}}},
    ):
        with pytest.raises(handoff_mod.HandoffError):
            handoff_mod.validate_handoff_constraints(invalid, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)
    result = handoff_mod.register_cross_domain_handoff(req, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)
    assert result["status"] == "SUCCESSOR_REGISTERED"
    saved = handoff_mod.load_handoff(hid, state_root=qroot)
    for key in ("payload_fingerprint", "request_key", "certification", "resolution_job_id", "dependency_satisfied"):
        assert saved[key] == record[key]
    assert handoff_mod.validate_handoff_constraints(req, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)["duplicate"] is True
    assert handoff_mod.register_cross_domain_handoff(req, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)["status"] == "EXISTS"
    conflict = {**req, "constraints": {**req["constraints"], "successor_spec": {**spec, "request_key": "different-successor"}}}
    with pytest.raises(handoff_mod.HandoffConflictError):
        handoff_mod.validate_handoff_constraints(conflict, current_user=actor, state_root=qroot)
